senses.gloss: estimate, appraisement, esp. the appraisement of valuables brought into marriage by the wife.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 66b:3">Keth. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ רבה</he> an appraisement of great proportions, <he>ש׳ זוטא</he> of small proportions; <he>ש׳ דידיה</he> his (the husband’s) appraisement, <he>ש׳ דידה</he> her appraisement (made in her paternal home).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 107a:8">B. Bath. 107ᵃ</cite> (if three appraisers differ) <he>עושין ש׳ ביניהן ומשלשין</he> we compromise between them by taking the difference between the highest and the lowest estimates and dividing it by three, i.e. by adding one-third of the difference to the lowest estimate; <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 11:2">Tosef. Keth. XI, 2</cite> <he>עושין אותה ש׳ ושמין אותה שליש</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>עושין שׁוּמָה ביניהן וכ׳</he>; oth. ed. <he>עושין אותו ש׳ ביניהן ושמין אותן שליש</he>). [<cite ref="Bava Kamma 95b:11">B. Kam. 95ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="U00440"><he>שומא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U00435"><he>שׁוּם</he> I</cite>].
